_comment: Self-build performance and memory baseline for the public release gate. Update with tools/check_perf_regression.ps1 -Update only after a justified intentional improvement; never raise ceilings to absorb a regression.
_windows_release_note: The Windows release gate enforces cold and hot self-host compile time, process-tree RSS, and compiler-only RSS. Hosted CI runners are correctness gates; performance baselines belong on a pinned machine.
_anti_compound_rule: Investigate drift before shipping. Baseline updates are only for measured improvements or deliberate budget changes with recorded rationale.
_perf_h_clawback_rationale: 2026-05-30: After §H landed, the rebuilt bin/nucleor.exe initially measured 4.69 s cold (vs 3.55 s on the OLD v1.1.1-era bin) -- a 32% regression. A/B against the OLD bin on identical current source confirmed byte-identical IR with 0 added drop calls in type_expr -- environmental Windows execution of the larger binary, not code. Resolution: rebuilt bin/nucleor.exe with -flto + -Wl,/OPT:ICF + -Wl,/OPT:REF (link-time optimization + identical code folding + dead-code stripping). Bin size 2.67 MB -> 1.18 MB (-56%), cold wall 4.69 s -> 3.30 s. Now FASTER than the OLD baseline (3.55 s) despite carrying all the post-v1.1.1 correctness work + §H. tools/bootstrap_windows.ps1 updated to use the same flags so future seed regens produce the optimized bin. Full investigation: PERF_H_CLAWBACK.md.
